artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathcal S$ denote the class of functions $f$ holomorphic and univalent on the unit disk $\mathbb D=\{z\in\mathbb C:|z|<1\}$ with $f(0)=0$ and $f'(0)=1$. For $\alpha\in[0,1)$, let
\[
K(\alpha)=\Big\{f\in\mathcal S:\operatorname{Re}\Big(1+\frac{zf''(z)}{f'(z)}\Big)\ge\alpha\text{ for all }z\in\mathbb D\Big\}
\]
be the class of convex functions of order $\alpha$, and
\[
S^{*}(\alpha)=\Big\{f\in\mathcal S:\operatorname{Re}\frac{zf'(z)}{f(z)}\ge\alpha\text{ for all }z\in\mathbb D\Big\}
\]
the class of starlike functions of order $\alpha$.

(a) Prove that for each $r\in(0,1)$,
\[
\min_{f\in K(\alpha)}\,\min_{|z|=r}\Big|\frac{zf'(z)}{f(z)}\Big|
\;=\;
\min_{f\in K(\alpha)}\,\min_{|z|=r}\operatorname{Re}\frac{zf'(z)}{f(z)}.
\]

(b) Show that the function
\[
g_{\alpha}(z)=\frac{1-(1-z)^{2\alpha-1}}{2\alpha-1}\quad(\alpha\neq\tfrac12),\qquad g_{1/2}(z)=-\log(1-z)
\]
belongs to $S^{*}(\beta)$ with the largest order
\[
\beta=\frac{4\alpha}{(2\alpha-1)\big(4-4\cdot 2^{\alpha}\big)}\quad(\alpha\neq\tfrac12),\qquad \beta=\frac{1}{\log 4}\quad(\alpha=\tfrac12).
\]

(c) Using either (a) or (b), determine
\[
\beta^{*}(\alpha)\;=\;\max\{\beta\in[0,1):K(\alpha)\subseteq S^{*}(\beta)\}.
\]
artifact.status_search_result: Jack (1971) addressed the inclusion $K(\alpha)\subseteq S^{*}(\beta)$ and obtained explicit values of $\beta$ for some ranges of $\alpha$, and the Marx–Strohhäcker result gives $K(0)\subseteq S^{*}(1/2)$. However, web searches did not yield a definitive citation that the full sharp value $\beta^{*}(\alpha)$ for all $\alpha\in[0,1)$, nor the auxiliary identity (a) in this exact form, has been established as the final answer. The status is therefore recorded as unknown.

status_evidence.title: Jack, I. (1971) Functions Starlike and Convex of Order α
status_evidence.snippet: Jack proposed the more general problem: What is the largest number β₀ which satisfies K ⊂ S*(β₀).
status_evidence.claim: Jack studied the inclusion of convex functions of order α in starlike classes, the framework in which Keogh's question is posed.

status_evidence.title: Examples of Starlike Functions and Convex Functions of order α
status_evidence.snippet: Marx and Strohhäcker showed K(0) ⊂ S*(1/2).
status_evidence.claim: Partial results (Marx–Strohhäcker, Jack) are known but a fully verified sharp value for all α was not located.
